descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
🤾 **The Ultimate VR Experience**

Football (soccer) gets rough. Boxing gets tactical.

Step onto the pitch where scoring goals is just as important as throwing punches — because here, the fight for the ball is literal. It’s football with gloves on. Play completely offline, master your skills, customize every detail, and lead your squad to victory.

Whether you want competitive league action or arcade-style fun, Boxing Football delivers intense gameplay, full team management, and total control in virtual reality.

---

🔥 **Game Modes**

- **Quick Match** – Jump straight into action by selecting home and visiting teams  
- **League** – Compete across a season and win prestigious trophies  
- **Tournament** – Face selected teams and fight for championship glory  
- **Training** – Practice dribbling, shooting, movement, and goalkeeping at your own pace  
- **Ball Smasher** – A fast, action-packed arcade mini-game  

---

🎮 **Deep Gameplay & Customization**

- Full **team and player management** - edit outfits, logos, team names, player names, body types, faces, and hairstyles  
- Customize **all 50 teams** in the game — create dream matchups  
- Extensive **gameplay settings** to tailor the experience your way  
- Add **fun hats** and visual flair to players  
- Activate **slow motion** for dramatic moments  
- Dynamic **commentary**, explosive **fire balls**, and flashy **score effects**  

---

🌍 **Locations**

- **Arena** – Classic indoor stadium atmosphere for major matches  
- **City Court** – Outdoor games with optional rain effects
